items.prompt: Exact half with odd quotient: EVEN does what?

options.why: At an exact half an odd lower quotient loses the tie to the adjacent even upper quotient.
The result depends on the quotient and remainder, not an instruction to round every tie to zero.
When the lower quotient is odd, adding one reaches the even adjacent integer required by half-even.
Exact ties are valid input; the explicit parity branch handles them without rejection.
